description: shrink around a CHOSEN TIME (mode 4): repeats the sound while shortening it, each repeat keeping the material around 'time' (in input seconds) and losing both edges - the generalisation of modes 1-3 (from-end / around-midpoint / from-start). Content-verified on a decaying ping: with time 0.05 the 4th repeat's envelope peaked at 0.693 = the source's level AT 0.05 s (mode 1 kept the 0.771 attack, mode 2 the 0.175 middle, mode 3 the 0.044 tail); all four modes rendered the SAME event grid (identical 1.9321 s durations, different content). Argv adds the leading time positional: time shrinkage gap contract dur spl. time is runtime-ranged 0 to the input duration ('Parameter[1] Value (0.400000) out of range (0.000000 to 0.300000)' on a 0.3 s source). Everything else re-verified identical to curated submode 1: contract >= shrinkage rule; duration exact at contract 1 (gap*ceil(dur/gap)); geometric early-halt at contract < 1 (banner's '(Minimum) duration' false without -m); -m regularises the grid out to dur and enables -r; -r is fixed-sequence pseudo-random (unseeded drand48 shim - byte-identical reruns, no seed exists); -s > indur segfaults; all params refuse breakpoints; -n equalise / -i per-segment reverse; stereo accepted.
musical_use: The focusable bounce: point 'time' at the feature you want to survive the shrinking - a vowel's core, the snap of a snare, the scrape in a texture - and every repeat zooms further into it, discarding context symmetrically. Sweeping time across renders (it is scalar-only) moves the microscope: early times give attack-centric bounces like mode 1, late times tail-ghosts like mode 3, and anything between isolates interior features modes 1-3 cannot reach. Great for turning long evolving sources into rhythmic figures whose repeats distil one moment; with contract just above shrinkage plus -m it lands as the same physical bounce-to-rest as submode 1. Level rides the source envelope at 'time' - centre on quiet material and add -n to bring the shrunk repeats up to match.

time.description: INPUT-time centre the shrinking preserves (runtime-enforced 0 to the input duration, refusal verbatim; negative refused). Each repeat keeps material around this point and sheds both edges (content-verified: repeat envelope matches the source's level at this time). Breakpoint refused.

shrinkage.description: Length factor per repeat, CDP-enforced 0-1 (0 legal = pure repeats). Must be <= contract. Breakpoint refused.

gap.description: Initial onset spacing; runtime floor = input duration, ceiling 60 (refusals verbatim in the submode-1 entry). Breakpoint refused.

contract.description: Gap-shortening factor per repeat, 0-1, runtime rule contract >= shrinkage ('Contraction of inter-events distance can't be less than shrinkage of sounds.'). 1.0 = equal spacing (duration model exact). Breakpoint refused.

dur.description: Target output duration; runtime floor = 2x input duration. Exact at contract 1 (gap*ceil(dur/gap)); at contract < 1 the series may halt earlier - '(Minimum)' is false without -m. Breakpoint refused.

spl.description: Splice length in ms, CDP-enforced 2-50; also the 2-splice shrink floor. Breakpoint refused.

small.description: Minimum sound length (repeats then stay equal). SEGFAULT if larger than the input duration (exit 139, family landmine). Breakpoint refused.

minsep.description: Minimum event separation - regularises the grid and lets the render reach dur; must be < gap (verbatim refusal). Precondition for -r. Breakpoint refused.

rnd.description: Timing jitter after the -m floor, 0-1. NO-OP without -m; FIXED-SEQUENCE when active (unseeded drand48 shim, byte-identical reruns - vary the value, not the run count). Breakpoint refused.

eqlevel.description: Equalise maximum level of output events - useful here whenever 'time' centres on quiet material (repeats otherwise ride the source's level at that point).

invert.description: Reverse each segment in the output (family-verified live).

examples.description: Zoom-bounce into a vowel's core at 0.8 s of a spoken phrase.
examples.expected_use: Repeats close in on the 0.8 s moment, shedding the phrase around it, tightening onto a 100 ms grid out to ~8 s.

examples.description: Equal-pulse distillation with predictable length and levelled repeats.
examples.expected_use: Steady 0.5 s grid, each repeat a shorter window around 0.15 s, levels equalised; output exactly 4.0 s.

known_issues: time is INPUT time and runtime-ranged 0..indur (refusal verbatim); it is scalar-only like every other param (all breakpoints refused, family-probed parameters 2-9 plus the extra leading slot).

Duration model exact only at contract = 1 (mode-4 boundary case re-verified: time 0.5 / gap 2.0 / dur 6.0 on a 2 s source rendered 6.0000 exactly as predicted); contract < 1 can halt before dur (family finding, same event grid as modes 1-3 - all four rendered 1.9321 s on the shared probe settings). Use -m to force the render out to dur. FLOAT BORDERLINE (family): a dur that is an exact decimal multiple of a non-binary-exact gap can gain one extra gap (0.9/0.3 -> 1.2).
-r no-op without -m; fixed-sequence when active (unseeded drand48 shim; byte-identical reruns verified in submode 1; no seed exists). stochastic: false, version_sensitive: true.
-s larger than the input duration segfaults (exit 139, no message).
Content rule (verified): each repeat's level follows the source envelope AT 'time' - quiet centres give quiet bounces; -n equalises.
Modes 5/6 (peak-segmentation variants) are multi-output and dropped - see docs/curation/tranche11a_iteration_findings.json.
